breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly adopted only the first sign convention (positive shear upward on the left cut face, positive moment causing sagging/tension at bottom fibers) and did not repeat or apply the contradictory redefinition (downward shear / hogging) that appeared in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth prompt which removes the conflicting redefinition entirely.
